comments.note: BreakTests.php uses class name `HubL_BreakTests` (namespace MailcodeTests\Translator\HubL). The HubL_ prefix was added to avoid a perceived collision with other classes named BreakTests, but PHP namespacing already provides isolation — the FQCN MailcodeTests\Translator\HubL\BreakTests would not conflict with MailcodeTests\Commands\Types\BreakTests or MailcodeTests\Factory\Commands\BreakTests. HubLSyntax.php still lacks the file-level `/** @package Mailcode @subpackage Translator */` block that all sibling translation files carry immediately after `<?php`. The class-level docblock was added by WP-004, which is correct, but the file-level block remains absent. Pre-existing omission not introduced by this plan. Consider adding it in a future consistency pass.

Dead-code hardcoded strings in BreakTranslation::translate() and ShowSnippetTranslation::translate() remain as duplicates of the canonical format. This is intentional and correctly constrained: test helpers cannot be imported into production code, and the methods are already annotated @codeCoverageIgnore/@internal. The plan's documented rationale is sound — no action needed.
